description: Fetch the Facebook home feed (首页信息流): the algorithmic timeline shown at facebook.com. Returns structured posts with author, text, permalink, time, media, and like/comment/share counts. Scrolls internally to load more posts, up to 100; partial=true when the stream ends early. Requires an active Facebook login.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum posts to return (1-100, default 20). The feed loads more posts on scroll; the command scrolls internally until the limit is reached or the stream is exhausted (partial=true).（条数上限，内部滚动加载；信息流是算法排序，无排序/时间参数。）
